court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Modoc
case_search_note: Public Case Portal: basic case info — recent filings, hearing schedule, parties. Court page does not say whether criminal cases are included. Documents by request: call (530) 233-6516. Weekly calendars: https://www.modoc.courts.ca.gov/general-information/court-calendar.

courthouses.name: Robert A. Barclay Justice Center (Modoc Superior Court)
courthouses.hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. (excluding holidays and court closures)
courthouses.note: Only courthouse in Modoc County; hears criminal, traffic, juvenile, civil, family, probate, small claims. Clerk email Clerk@modoc.courts.ca.gov; fax (530) 233-6500. Zoom appearances available (court's Zoom page). Staff won't look up records by phone.
courthouses.todo: No separate criminal clerk phone on official pages (a search summary cited (530) 233-6515 — not verified). Department list not published.

public_defenders.name: Modoc County Public Defender — Law Office of Jacob Levin
public_defenders.address: County of Modoc Courthouse, 204 South Court Street
public_defenders.hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (closed 12–1) — county department hours
public_defenders.note: County Public Defender page lists two attorneys by name with their own law-office phone numbers (i.e., attorneys under the Public Defender department, emails obfuscated). County courthouse main line: (530) 233-7660. Address shown is the county courthouse on the PD page, not necessarily the attorney's office.

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Redding Office (Shasta Regional)
legal_aid.serves: Lassen, Modoc, Shasta, Siskiyou and Tehama counties (civil legal aid)
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing, public benefits, education rights, healthcare benefits, guardianship help for grandparents 55+. Office page does not list criminal defense or record clearing. Modoc court's resource page lists the toll-free line (800) 822-9687.
legal_aid.hours: Intake Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 9:00–11:45 a.m. and 1:00–4:45 p.m.

legal_aid.name: Modoc County Victim Witness
legal_aid.what: Victim advocacy and restitution information (not defense).

probation.name: Modoc County Probation Department
probation.hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; closed 12:00–1:00 p.m.; closed weekends
probation.note: Adult and juvenile supervision, pre-sentence reports, electronic monitoring (GPS/home detention) as alternative to incarceration, Batterer's Intervention Program. Online 'Find My Supervisor' map linked from the directory. No pretrial program described.

programs.name: Electronic Monitoring (GPS / home detention)
programs.summary: Probation provides GPS or home-detention monitoring for approved cases as an alternative to incarceration.

programs.name: Batterer's Intervention Program
programs.summary: Court-mandated domestic-violence prevention treatment run through Probation.

jails.name: Modoc County Jail (Sheriff's Office)
jails.phone_note: Sheriff main/after-hours line; court lists this number for custody/inmate information. Fax (530) 233-4971.
jails.visiting_note: In person Wednesdays and Saturdays: women check in 9:45–9:55 a.m. (visit 10–11), men 1:45–1:55 p.m. (visit 2–3), protective custody 2:45–2:55 p.m. (visit 3–4). Late arrivals denied. Bring ID. People on probation/parole need a signed letter. Video visits via CIDNet (customer.cidnet.net/register).
jails.note: Houses both: visitation page has separate women's and men's visiting times. Court is the county's only courthouse; transport route not stated (nearest, not confirmed).
jails.todo: No official money/commissary deposit info or online inmate lookup found. No juvenile hall found in county.
